items.title: JPMorgan Sees $450 Billion AI Debt Blitz in 2027 Before Plateau
items.summary: Companies will tap public high-grade debt markets for $450 billion next year to finance their artificial intelligence-related capital expenditures, even as a growth plateau looms for the burgeoning industry further down the road, according to analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.

items.title: Citigroup (C) Explores Venezuela Banking Return As It Seeks Sanctions Waivers
items.summary: Citigroup (NYSE:C) is in talks with U.S. officials about resuming banking services in Venezuela after a five year hiatus. The bank is exploring potential sanctions waivers that would be required before offering services to clients in the Venezuelan market. Citi exited most banking activities in Venezuela in 2019, keeping only limited operations focused on winding down prior business.
